## Episode Thesis

This is a company-hosted interview with United Bankers CEO John Ojanperä about the H1'26 results. He reported turnover of €30.4m, the second-best half-year in the company's history, and assets under management up to a record €5.8bn, helped by the acquisitions of Fondita and Forton. The main themes were weak inflows into alternative and special funds, a new push on sales outside Finland, the target of €10bn AUM by 2028 with about half coming from acquisitions, and data-centre and renewable-energy land opportunities after a sale to Google. The CEO was upbeat about the market outlook, but neither the host nor any analyst gave an investment recommendation.
